title: Reviewing a prototype vibration chart

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I’m preparing the vibration chart for tomorrow’s customer call. The largest spike is at the far right. I thought I should circle it as the worst result.
turns.zh: 我在準備明天與客戶通話要用的振動圖。最大尖峰在最右側。我想把它圈起來，當作最差的測試結果。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Check the grey band on the chart. It marks the time after we switched the motor off. That spike is from lifting the unit off the stand, not from running the motor.
turns.zh: 看圖上的灰色區段。那是馬達關閉後的時段。尖峰是把機體抬離支架時造成的，不是馬達運轉造成的。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Should I crop the chart at the motor shutoff, so the customer doesn’t have to see the grey band?
turns.zh: 我要從馬達關閉的地方裁掉後面，讓客戶不用看灰色區段嗎？

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Keep the full chart. Add a note explaining the grey band, and circle the largest spike to the left of it.
turns.zh: 保留整張圖，加註灰色區段的意思，並圈出它左側最大的尖峰。
